contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ GLOR IA EXERC ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Trier mint Gloria exercitus issue of 332-333, RIC volume 7 no. 539, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. The soldiers hold spears points downward, and the figure on the left may wear leg-bands or garters, and wears a broad brimmed helmet. The standards are capped by sub-triangular objects with a central space, possibly representing eagles with wings raised. Reverse inscription: GLOR IA EXERC ITVS. In exergue: TR.P. Diameter: 16.6mm, Weight: 2.15gms, die axis: 6
